items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: I don't even know Joe Wilder. Who is Joe Wilder?

ctx.x: Well Joe Wilder has passed now, but this would have been in the mid—'40s.
I don't even know Joe Wilder. Who is Joe Wilder?
Joe Wilder is a wonderful trumpet player. And he aspired to a classical career but there was no such thing for him.
